items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Converts CSC compose JSON into an in-memory D2P GHComponent. Geometry is registered as a nested MemberGeo tree (D2P ParentMember + : layer paths). Optional Parent prefixes ShortName for D2P child naming. CSC identity/snapshot metadata is stored on the component label user text. MeshMode: best | inline | reduced | detailed | all. SnapshotScope: current | all.
Converts to collection of text fragments
Standard output and error contents collected during script run
